title: Genes selection using deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence for chronic lymphocytic leukemia predicting the need and time to therapy
summary: Original full text, Methods/Results: autoencoder and SHAP feature selection on expression profiles yielded CLL therapy-need/time-to-first-treatment model; prospective observational cohort but model evaluation retrospective (217 analyzed); test AUC 0.91. Prognostic association, not prospective clinical utility. Methods/Results specify cohort, reference/outcome, split or experimental comparator and limitations.
